verdict.rationale: Before any flow starts, DPMA's public pages state the credential requirement for each filing route. DPMAdirektWeb lets you file trade marks and designs without a signature card. DPMAdirektPro requires a signature card plus downloaded application software for patents. ePCT works without a signature card, and paper or fax filing is also available. The evidence does not lay out the full account or identity-proofing sequence, so only part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: explicit account-registration requirements, identity-proofing steps such as how a signature card is obtained or verified, a single end-to-end list of prerequisites, and independent or hands-on confirmation that nothing extra surfaces mid-flow.
